request: Aide XLSX 预览单元格按钮显示 Office script failed
initial_status: Clean isolated worktree at the recorded main revision.
acceptance: Open XLSX Cells when the first tab is an Excel chart sheet.
Show the regular worksheets in workbook order and allow existing authorized cell edits to save and read back.
Explain how to preview a chart sheet when specifically requested in Cells.
scope: Built-in XLSX cell view and its HTTP regression tests. Preserve LibreOffice layout, workbook access checks and current parser limits.

requirements.summary: The user reported an Office script failure when clicking XLSX Cells. A synthetic workbook with a chart sheet first reproduces the error through the same handler. The exact workbook and detailed error from the reported instance were unavailable.

design.summary: The Cells selector and default use worksheets that provide a cell grid. Explicit chart-sheet requests direct the user to the existing layout preview.

implementation.summary: Filtered the XLSX cell-view sheet list while retaining the existing workbook order and write API.

verification.summary: The new chart-first fixture failed before the adjustment with HTTP 400 and Chartsheet.max_row missing. Five focused Go tests passed after the adjustment using a network-disabled Linux ARM64 container, Go 1.26.11 and openpyxl 3.1.5. The regression covers default and alternate worksheets, edit and readback, and the explicit chart-sheet response. Existing client file request ownership tests passed. In the isolated browser, the normal Cells button reproduced HTTP 400 before the change. After the change the same UI defaulted to Data and saved and reopened B2. The daily browser opened and switched the same synthetic chart-first workbook. The separate daily edit test wrote the fixture, then returned a history archive I/O error in the shared data mount.

documentation.summary: Recorded the reproduction, artifact, verification and scope of the fix in this task file.

cleanup.summary: Removed the disposable test containers and dedicated Go cache. Kept the synthetic workbook and focused test logs with the isolated worktree. Removed the three temporary daily workspace workbooks after checking the fixture path.

release.summary: Local deployment completed on the running daily Aide by replacing the verified built-in Python asset atomically. The browser test and health/integrity passed on the same container. Its local source copy and next-start image contain the same script. A public Aide release was out of scope.

release_authorization: User-reported local product bug. Source and daily configuration verification are local.
rollback: Restore the previously verified bundled Python script if needed. The previous image is retained under aide:daily-before-xlsx-cells-20261118.
handoff: The chart-first fault is covered by HTTP and browser regression evidence. The exact reported workbook requires its detailed error or a separate verified reproduction.
